title: Source: src/agent_runtime/console
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/console

src/agent_runtime/console/init.py

Python · Tier A

Expose the diagnostic publisher and lazily load the sidecar application factory. Main-server callers can import heartbeat/event adapters without importing the sampler and HTTP routes. The package owns no background process or sampler at import time; startup and the sidecar lifespan own those resources.

src/agent_runtime/console/app.py

Python · Tier A

Serve the independent diagnostic console over the installation login boundary. create_console_app resolves target/port settings, owns a process sampler and UDP collector through lifespan, and exposes cached snapshots, an optional SSE stream and explicit stack capture. Page/static handlers use installed branding and error assets. Snapshot requests do not query GPU hardware; the sampling thread does. This app reports observations and cannot settle tasks or authorize execution.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
create_console_app 56 Build the sidecar with explicit arguments or environment defaults, attaching sampler/collector state and portal authentication. Its lifespan starts background workers; constructing the app alone does not bind the UDP socket or sample the target.
create_console_app.error_presentation 137 Serve the fixed shared UI asset aliases from the installed Agent package. The route allowlist selects filenames; generic console assets use a separate containment check.
create_console_app.healthz 151 Report sidecar availability, target identity and cached sample/main status. The outer authentication layer reduces anonymous health responses; this status does not certify fresh main-server heartbeats.
create_console_app.console_page 165 Load and brand the installed console shell with a private no-store response. Return a readable missing-assets page if the shell is absent; this handler does not start the main Agent.
create_console_app.console_static 190 Resolve a requested asset beneath the console static directory, rejecting missing files and path escapes. Select CSS/JavaScript media types while leaving file delivery to FileResponse.
create_console_app.console_snapshot 206 Return the current in-memory process/event projection and deterministic findings. Reading a snapshot performs no process sample or GPU query.
create_console_app.console_stack 213 Request the sampler’s explicit signal-based stack capture and return its captured/timeout/unsupported/failure result. Portal authentication and mutation checks run before this route.
create_console_app.console_stream 219 Offer periodic cached snapshots as named SSE events. The bundled browser uses polling instead; this endpoint neither samples hardware nor controls task state.

src/agent_runtime/console/collector.py

Python · Tier A

Receive best-effort diagnostic datagrams for the console sampler. ConsoleUdpCollector owns one IPv4 UDP socket and daemon receiver thread. It accepts JSON objects, ignores malformed packets and recorder failures, and delegates target PID/process-birth filtering to the sampler. Transport supplies no delivery acknowledgement, replay or sender authentication; HTTP login does not wrap UDP.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ConsoleUdpCollector 17 Receive bounded diagnostic packets from the main Agent server.
ConsoleUdpCollector.start 32 Start one daemon receiver unless it is already alive. Socket creation and bind happen in the worker, so this method does not prove listener readiness.
ConsoleUdpCollector.stop 41 Signal shutdown, close an existing socket to unblock receive, and wait at most one second for the worker. Repeated close errors are ignored.
ConsoleUdpCollector._run 55 Bind the configured IPv4 UDP address and receive at most 65535 bytes per datagram. Ignore malformed/non-object JSON and recorder errors, then close the socket on exit; a bind failure ends the worker rather than retrying.

src/agent_runtime/console/diagnosis.py

Python · Tier A

Classify visible console measurements without inference or execution authority. diagnose consumes one snapshot and returns at most eight severity-ranked findings with observed evidence and a next check. Fixed thresholds cover missing process, heartbeat age, CPU/memory, occupied slots, stage hints and recent HTTP latency. These heuristics suggest investigations; they do not prove root cause, restart services, dispatch tools or determine whether a task effect succeeded.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
diagnose 48 Return process-down immediately, otherwise rank fixed heartbeat/resource/slot/latency rules and the first matching LLM or execution-stage hint. Use request age for stage severity, not measured model-call duration; emit a neutral finding when no rule matches.

src/agent_runtime/console/gpu.py

Python · Tier A

Sample device-wide local NVIDIA telemetry in the sidecar worker. NvidiaGpuProvider uses one fixed nvidia-smi CSV query with a 0.75-second subprocess timeout and the shared GPU parser. Failed or empty observations clear readings and delay another attempt for 30 seconds. Aggregate utilization is the maximum available device reading; VRAM is summed used/total across usable devices. These values are host observations, not Agent-process attribution or Gateway inventory.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
NvidiaGpuProvider 22 Read all local NVIDIA GPUs without requiring a Python driver dependency. Called only by the console sampling worker. Missing drivers/devices and failed commands back off; unsupported individual metrics remain null in the API.
NvidiaGpuProvider.sample 40 Query local devices when retry time permits, retaining no stale device values after failure. Return explicit availability, null missing metrics and an explanatory message; successful samples permit another query on the next worker tick. The subprocess uses fixed argv without a shell.

src/agent_runtime/console/publisher.py

Python · Tier A

Publish main-server diagnostics without making the console an execution owner. ConsoleDiagnostics owns an independent thread heartbeat, asyncio lag probe and optional SIGUSR2 faulthandler registration. HTTP middleware times response creation; ConsoleEventSink can mirror supplied pipeline events after log-policy projection and size limits. ConsolePublisher sends process-identified UDP packets without acknowledgement or retry, retaining send errors locally. Heartbeat summaries are bounded store observations, not a durable event journal or complete task history.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
utc_now_iso 34 Timestamp emitted diagnostic envelopes in UTC so the sidecar can display their source time alongside its separate receive time.
console_host 51 Resolve the publisher destination from AOR_CONSOLE_HOST, falling back to loopback for an unset or blank value.
console_bind_host 57 Resolve the sidecar collector bind address, defaulting to the publisher host. The web bundle separately chooses the HTTP listener bind address.
console_port 63 Read the console HTTP port, using 8015 when its environment value is absent or not an integer. This helper does not validate port range or availability.
console_udp_port 72 Read the independent diagnostic UDP port, defaulting to the HTTP port when absent or unparsable.
console_sidecar_url 82 Construct the console navigation URL from the active certificate protocol and configured HTTP port. Replace wildcard display hosts with loopback; the supplied host is for navigation, not a listener rebind.
console_stack_path 93 Resolve the append-only stack-log path shared by the main faulthandler and sidecar reader. A relative default follows the process working directory.
_bounded_diagnostic_value 100 Apply the configured LOGS redaction projection once, then bound nesting, strings, keys and collections for mirrored pipeline events. Other publisher payloads do not automatically pass through this adapter.
ConsolePublisher 135 Fire-and-forget UDP publisher used by the main Agent server.
ConsolePublisher.emit 161 Wrap a caller payload with PID, process birth, sequence and timestamps, replacing payloads above 60000 encoded bytes with a truncation marker. Send once through a lazy UDP socket and retain transport errors instead of raising them into the Agent request.
ConsolePublisher.health_measurements 207 Return detached, content-free last observations for passive health readers.
ConsolePublisher.close 214 Detach and close the current UDP socket, ignoring close errors. A later enabled emit can create another socket.
ConsoleEventSink 224 Observability sink that mirrors pipeline events to the console sidecar.
ConsoleEventSink.emit 233 Project and bound a supplied PipelineEvent before emitting its diagnostic envelope. Failures remain isolated from the caller; exposing this sink on app.state does not itself attach it to every request observer.
ConsoleDiagnostics 243 Main-server heartbeat, HTTP timing, and stack-dump integration.
ConsoleDiagnostics.start 267 When publication is enabled, register optional stack dumping, start the thread heartbeat once and schedule the lag probe on the running event loop. No-loop callers retain the thread path without a probe task.
ConsoleDiagnostics.stop 287 Signal and briefly join the heartbeat worker, cancel the loop probe, close the publisher and unregister/close any stack-dump resources.
ConsoleDiagnostics._loop_probe 332 Measure excess asyncio sleep delay using the monotonic clock and publish lag heartbeats until shutdown. The independent thread heartbeat can remain fresh when this loop is blocked.
ConsoleDiagnostics._heartbeat_payload 358 Read up to 100 open run summaries and 500 queued tasks, derive slots, include thread identities and bounded previews, and report server navigation details. Store read failures substitute empty results; these counts are bounded observations rather than total workload authority.
install_console_http_middleware 458 Install one start/finish timing adapter around HTTP response creation. Request handling retains its return value or exception; diagnostic publication is best effort.

src/agent_runtime/console/sampler.py

Python · Tier A

Join independent process/GPU samples with best-effort main-server observations. ConsoleSampler pins the target PID and its initial OS birth time for packet acceptance, maintains bounded sample/event/stack rings, and projects cached snapshots through deterministic diagnosis. Heartbeats replace current run facts; pipeline hints are merged separately and may outlive an active run. Stack capture signals the configured PID and reads an append-only shared log. Snapshot reads do not collect hardware data, persist controller state or authorize recovery.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
utc_now_iso 29 Timestamp sampler observations and stack results in UTC independently of producer timestamps.
RingBuffer 46 Keep a fixed-capacity deque behind an RLock, dropping the oldest item when full. Returned lists are shallow snapshots; nested records are not deep-copied.
RingBuffer.append 54 Append one observation under the ring lock and let deque capacity evict the oldest item.
RingBuffer.list 60 Copy the current ordered item references under the lock so iteration does not race deque mutation.
RingBuffer.latest 65 Return the newest retained item, or None before the first observation.
ConsoleSampler 74 Sample process health and merge main-server diagnostic packets.
ConsoleSampler.__init__ 80 Capture target birth time when accessible, clamp interval/window, and allocate sample, 2000-event and 10-stack rings. Initialize separate latest-heartbeat/request maps, GPU reader and shared stack path without starting workers.
ConsoleSampler.start 121 Start one daemon sampling worker unless already alive. Its lifetime is owned by the sidecar app rather than an HTTP request.
ConsoleSampler.stop 132 Signal the sampling loop and wait at most 1.5 seconds for its worker. In-progress sampling is not forcibly interrupted.
ConsoleSampler.sample_once 165 Collect one target-process observation, attach local GPU telemetry even if the target is missing, append to the sample ring and return that observation.
ConsoleSampler._sample_process 174 Read target CPU/memory, threads, handles, connections and host pressure. Compute nonnegative thread-CPU and I/O deltas, retaining the eight busiest threads; target lookup or guarded psutil read failures produce a missing-process sample.
ConsoleSampler.record_event 275 Reject packets whose PID/birth time differs from the initially observed target, then append and merge recognized kinds. Heartbeats replace active summaries, pipeline events retain latest per-request stage, and HTTP events track inflight keys; sequence numbers do not deduplicate or reorder packets.
ConsoleSampler.capture_stack 350 Send SIGUSR2 to the configured PID and wait up to 1.5 seconds for appended log bytes, returning the last 24000 characters and retaining the result. The target must already own the handler; this path does not verify registration or recheck process birth before signalling.
ConsoleSampler.snapshot 501 Assemble cached process, GPU history, request hints, runtime counts, 120 recent events and latest stack result, then classify findings. Connected means a heartbeat has ever arrived; age expresses freshness. The constituent reads are not one controller transaction.

src/agent_runtime/console/static/console.css

CSS · Tier A

Agent UI reference tokens, served entirely by the Console sidecar.

src/agent_runtime/console/static/console.html

HTML · Tier A

Provide the authenticated diagnostic console shell for process bottlenecks, active requests and system observations.

src/agent_runtime/console/static/console.js

JavaScript · Tier A

Present the independent console's cached process, GPU and diagnostic observations. Poll JSON every second with overlapping reads coalesced, render literal-text cards and timestamped charts, and send stack capture only on explicit activation. The backend owns sampling, diagnosis and signals. This browser neither consumes the optional SSE endpoint nor controls task execution; absent readings stay visible as gaps/placeholders. Shared error/busy adapters own request feedback.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
text 16 * Write a display value through textContent when the target exists, preserving literal text * rather than interpreting diagnostic content as HTML.
fmtPercent 25 * Show a rounded percentage, keeping missing telemetry as a dash placeholder and preserving an * observed zero.
fmtBytes 35 * Format byte measurements using binary thresholds and compact units. Missing observations remain * distinct from zero bytes.
fmtMs 48 * Format a present duration in milliseconds or seconds, retaining a placeholder for missing * heartbeat/lag measurements.
api 59 * Read JSON through the shared error-aware request adapter and throw the canonical error for a * failed HTTP response. Callers own visible error presentation and busy state.
item 69 * Create a literal-text diagnostic card with optional severity metadata. Titles, event data and * suggested next checks do not become HTML.
fact 84 * Create a compact labelled measurement using text nodes for both value and caption.
chartContext 100 * Clear a canvas, draw its background/grid using existing display tokens, and return geometry * plus drawing helpers for the current render.
color 115 * Resolve the named existing CSS property for this chart render without changing the saved * appearance preference.
renderChart 134 * Draw process CPU/memory and optional busiest-GPU history, then match each per-device series by * stable device ID. All chart data comes from the accepted snapshot.
renderHistory 158 Text/data alternative stays quiet during background polling.
time 167 Not yet documented
drawSeries 182 * Draw the latest 120 timestamp-spaced points on a 0–100 scale. Missing or nonfinite readings * break the path instead of implying zero or bridging an observation gap.
renderGpu 211 * Replace local-device cards, summary availability and accessible chart labels from one snapshot. * Missing metrics remain placeholders, and absent devices remove old cards rather than retaining * stale readings.
reading 249 * Format one optional device measurement with its unit; a null value remains unavailable * instead of being rounded to zero.
render 272 * Store the last snapshot and rebuild process facts, findings, request hints, recent events and * charts. Display supplied text literally, cap the visible event list at forty, and never infer * task completion from telemetry.
refresh 361 * Coalesce overlapping timer/manual snapshot reads into one pending promise. Render its result, * show shared errors on failure and finish any manual busy indicator; polling performs no * hardware query itself.
captureStack 378 * Post an explicit stack-capture request, display its returned text/status and refresh cached * observations. The server owns signal delivery; a busy indicator does not cancel or deduplicate * concurrent capture requests.
